coalesced.measurement: recursive sys.getsizeof over cache-owned roots with identity deduplication

sliced.measurement: recursive sys.getsizeof over cache-owned roots with identity deduplication

scope: Synthetic routes. Coalesced and sliced engines use exact projected reads and the same release obligations; sliced evaluation changes the cached computation unit. Complete-snapshot difference is charged separately. Page parsing and builder time are excluded.
timing: Each change kind runs in an isolated process. Within a kind, each timing series uses a two-direction warmup and alternating paired updates; series order rotates by kind and only one cache is retained at a time. Issue sets are materialized on every path. Repeats are process observations, not independent sites.
